title: Library Adapter Preparation
author: Franziska Aron
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bem5jc86

steps.title: Prepare P5 Adapter
steps.instruction: Set up the P5 adapter mix (100 µL per reaction) in a 0.2 ml PCR strip tube.

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette up and down to mix.
Split the 100 µL reaction into two 0.2 ml PCR strip tubes (50 µL each).

steps.title: Prepare P7 Adapter
steps.instruction: Set up the P7 adapter mix (100 µL per reaction) in a 0.2 ml PCR strip tube.

substeps.instruction: Split the 100 µL reaction into two 0.2 ml PCR strip tubes (50 µL each).

steps.title: Prepare Oligo Hybridization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL of oligo hybridization buffer at 10× concentration (sufficient for 50 reactions).

substeps.instruction: Irradiate the buffer with UV for 00:30:00 without the lid or with an open lid.

steps.title: Combine P5 and P7 Adapters
steps.instruction: Combine one P5 adapter reaction (50 µL) with one P7 adapter reaction (50 µL) in one tube.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by flicking the tubes with a finger and spin down briefly.
Repeat the process with the second set of P5 and P7 adapter reactions to obtain two 0.2 ml tubes, each containing 100 µL total volume.

steps.title: Hybridize Adapters
steps.instruction: Incubate both reactions in a thermocycler with a heated lid.

substeps.instruction: Cool down from 95 °C to 12 °C at a rate of 0.1 °C per second.

steps.title: Create Ready-to-Use Adapter Mix
steps.instruction: Combine both reactions into a 2 ml tube to obtain a ready-to-use double-stranded library adapter mix with 100 µM adapter (each).

steps.title: Dilute and Aliquot Adapter Mix
steps.instruction: Dilute the double-stranded library adapter mix to 10 µM using UV HPLC-water.

substeps.instruction: Add 1800 µL of UV HPLC-water to the mix.
Aliquot the dilution into 10 × 1.5 ml LoBind tubes, each containing 200 µL.
Briefly vortex and spin down before freezing.

steps.title: Store Adapter Mix
steps.instruction: Store the adapter mix aliquots at -20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Note: Each aliquot is sufficient for 200 reactions (2000 libraries total) and can be thawed and re-frozen.
